title: A model measure that references an overridden measure keeps using the model definition
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[Sales Amount] = SUM ( Sales[Quantity] )

source.quote: However, its definition is only used in other query measures; other model measures continue to use the model measure definition.
source.supports: a model measure does not see the query definition

source.quote: Measure definitions for a query override model measures of the same name.
source.supports: the Microsoft page states the override without that limit

derivation: [Double Amount] is a model measure, so by the DAX Guide statement its [Sales Amount] is the model one: 540 * 2 = 1080. A fixed decimal times an integer is a fixed decimal.
alternative: The Microsoft pages say only that the query measure overrides the model measure of the same name. If the override also applies inside model measures, [Sales Amount] is 15 there and the result is the integer 30.
